news: Gemini and OpenCode join Claude, ChatGPT and Grok, and any OpenAI- or Claude-compatible API works too.
Setup takes four steps: connect your model, make a companion and give it a first task.
Give each companion its own look: a body, colors, a face and extras.
See every fact a companion remembers and where it came from, and change or forget any of it.
Deleting a chat, a companion or your data asks first, then gives you a few seconds to undo.
